reference: Neos Hellenomnemon 16 (1922), printed p. 10 (left column), beginning 'Μεγαλαυχοῦσι γὰρ τὸ δυσσεβὲς καὶ θεομισὲς καὶ παμμίαρον τοῦτο γένος' (Olympias doc.pdf)
gist_en: Palamas describes the Turks as an impious, god-hating and filthy race that boasts and ravages Christian lands and people; the sentence is an insult against a people.
why_excluded: Ethnic insult against the Turks as a people; excluded by the exclusion rule. The surrounding doctrinal lines are included as separate passages.
